subject: DPA redline consolidation + signature routing for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Alice Moroz <alice.moroz@acmecorp.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-28T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: DPA and security addendum for Redwood instance

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited about moving forward. Procurement has asked us to get a signed DPA and confirmation of SCCs in place before the PO can be approved. Attached is our standard DPA (Acme_DPA_Request.pdf) plus a short questionnaire we run for subprocessors.

Can you confirm Redwood's ability to:
- Sign our DPA or accept our limited redlines
- Execute SCCs (we prefer EU addendum if applicable)
- Provide SOC 2 report or SIG Lite evidence (we can accept a SOC 2 Type II summary)

What is the typical timeline for legal review and signature? Also, do you have a preferred signature tool (DocuSign) and standard internal approver list?

If easier, I can loop in our legal lead (ben.chen@acmecorp.com) — copied.

Thanks,
Alice Moroz
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp

Attachment: Acme_DPA_Request.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moroz <alice.moroz@acmecorp.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-28T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and security addendum for Redwood instance

Alice — thanks, appreciate the clarity. Looping in Karthik (legal) and Neha (security/compliance) to review Acme's DPA and the questionnaire. Laura (AE) is on the thread for commercial alignment.

Plan:
1) Legal to provide a Redwood redline and short summary of any non-standard asks (target: 24–48 hours).
2) Security to note which artifacts are already available (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ pointers).
3) If both sides can align on limited language, we will route for signature via DocuSign and update the HubSpot deal record.

Karthik/Neha — can you take a look and advise next steps? 48-hour turnaround preferred.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and security addendum for Redwood instance

Priyom — reviewed Acme's DPA. Attached is Redwood_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf with in-line comments. High level:
- We can accept most commercial terms; primary concern is the broad data return/destruction language (Section 4) and the subcontractor/subprocessor notification window (we typically offer 30 days notice).
- Suggest we accept SCCs where required but ask Acme to confirm territory (EU transfers only vs global).
- For audits: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and an option for a SIG Lite response; full SOC 2 report requires an NDA/obligation to keep redacted copy as per policy.

Recommend: propose our redlines, offer DocuSign for signature, and ask Acme to confirm which SCC variant they need. If Acme requires different commercial concessions, escalate to Sales leadership for a one-off approval.

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Chen <ben.chen@acmecorp.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Moroz <alice.moroz@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-09-29T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and security addendum for Redwood instance

Priyom / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We've reviewed Redwood's redline and have a couple counterpoints in our attached file (ACME_DPA_Counter.docx). Main asks: a 60-day retention exception for archival backups, and a slightly longer notification window (45 days) for subprocessor changes.

On signature: we prefer DocuSign but can accept signed PDF if Redwood requires internal approvals that can't be completed through DocuSign. Please confirm the routing (who signs first at Redwood) and the expected timeline to get an executed DPA.

On audits: we can accept SOC 2 Type II summary for procurement, but our security team will request SIG Lite responses before go-live. Are those publicly hosted or will you provide a bespoke link?

Best,
Ben Chen
Corporate Counsel, Acme Corp

Attachment: ACME_DPA_Counter.docx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Chen <ben.chen@acmecorp.com>, Alice Moroz <alice.moroz@acmecorp.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and security addendum for Redwood instance

Ben / Alice — thanks. Quick consolidated plan from Redwood: 
- Legal note: Redwood can accept a 60-day archival exception if we add a scoped carve-out limiting archival access and maintain encryption-at-rest controls. Karthik to finalize language (small concession).
- Subprocessor notification: we can move to 45 days for Acme (one-off concession), but require a quarterly public subprocessor list and an emergency 7-day notice for critical changes.
- Audit artifacts: Neha to provide links to SOC 2 summary and a hosted SIG Lite export (we'll provide a read-only link shortly).

Signature routing/proposal:
1) Karthik to incorporate the agreed small concessions, produce final DPA for signature.
2) Marissa (Sales VP) will approve commercial concessions and authorize signature.
3) Priyom to send DocuSign envelope to Acme primary contact after signatures from Redwood signatory (Legal or Sales as required).

Tentative timeline: revise & send final DPA by EOD 9/30; signature via DocuSign 9/30–10/01. DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://na1.docusign.net/envelope12345

Requesting Marissa and Karthik to confirm approval path so I can update HubSpot (link below).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and security addendum for Redwood instance

All — reviewed the proposed concessions. I approve the 60-day archival carve-out and the 45-day subprocessor notice for this one-off deal. Karthik, please include the scoped language about encryption and limited access. Neha, please post the SOC 2 summary and SIG export to the read-only link and flag any open items.

Priyom — proceed with DocuSign once Karthik uploads the finalized DPA. Update the HubSpot record with the executed DPA and mark the procurement stage as "Legal Approved". If Acme requests any further commercial adjustments, escalate to me immediately.

Marissa Cole
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
